title: SIDESTORY: WHERE VERNAL WINDS WILL NEVER BLOW OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: WHERE VERNAL WINDS WILL NEVER BLOW OPEN
DURATION: July 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 18, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from the Event Store.
EVENT STAGES DURATION: Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
- [Case Investigation, Onsite] Duration: July 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 11, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- [Criminal Pursuit, Offsite] Duration: August 4, 2023, 16:00 (UTC-7) - August 11, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Yumen Arena Board of Fame
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Yumen Arena Board of Fame] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Jieyun, Yumen Clinic Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Newly-Distilled Liedaozi, etc.
Sword Forge
DURATION: July 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 18, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Newly-Distilled Liedaozi by clearing event stages and completing Yumen Arena Board of Fame missions. Newly-Distilled Liedaozi can be used to redeem items from [Sword Forge].
MAIN REWARDS: Jieyun's Token, Yumen Clinic Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, etc.
- During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – SOLITUDE UNIVERSAL
DURATION: July 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 11, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Solitude Universal], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Chongyue (Limited) / Lin
★★★★★★: Nian (Limited) / Dusk (Limited) / Ling (Limited)
★★★★★: Firewhistle
NOTE:
- [Solitude Universal] is part of the [Limited Headhunting - Festival] headhunting series.
- Operator Lin and Firewhistle will be permanently added to other Standard Headhuntings in future update.
- Operator Chongyue is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Festival], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.
- Please refer to the official notice of the [Limited Headhunting - Festival] for more details.
03 LIMITED-TIME LOGIN EVENT OPEN - SOLITUDE UNIVERSAL
DURATION: July 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 11, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Log in during the event to claim reward on event page: Winds of Millennia Unyielding Headhunting Permit * 1
NOTE:
- Winds of Millennia Unyielding Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in [Solitude Universal] Limited Headhunting.
- Winds of Millennia Unyielding Headhunting Permit expires at: August 11, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Each account can only claim this reward once during the event.
04 DAILY FREE ROLL IN [SOLITUDE UNIVERSAL] LIMITED HEADHUNTING
DURATION: July 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 11, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: A free roll can be performed every day during the event in [Solitude Universal] Limited Headhunting.
NOTE:
- Daily Free Roll will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) every day.
- Daily Free Roll can only be used once a day and will not accumulate.
05 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE
★★★★★★: Chongyue (Limited)
★★★★★: Firewhistle
★★★★★: Jieyun
DETAILS:
- Operator Chongyue is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Festival], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.
- Operator Jieyun is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
- Operator Chongyue, Lin, Firewhistle, and Jieyun will gain more trust in the event stages.
06 LUNGMEN LUCKY STRIPS EVENT OPEN
DURATION: July 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 11, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can get two trials for Lungmen Lucky Strips after daily login. Between the Lucky Stirps you picked, the one with the higher amount of Orundum will be the final daily reward. Players need to use all trials to get the reward.
NOTE:
- There are 14 days at most for players to pick Lucky Strips.
- Players will randomly obtain following amount of Orundum from Lucky Strips:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 400, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 600, Orundum * 800

- If the amount of Orundum in daily reward is less than 400 (400 is NOT included), players will be granted an extra trial the next day. The extra trial cannot be accumulated, players can get 3 daily trials at most (including the extra trial).
- All the daily trials will be refreshed at 4:00 am on the next day and cannot be accumulated.
07 0011 SERIES NEW ARRIVALS AND RE-EDITIONS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: July 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 18, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- 0011 Productions - It Does Wash the Strings for Ling
- 0011 Productions - Illumination That of Daylights for Cantabile
- 0011 Productions - Reflection That of the Moons for Mulberry
DURATION: July 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 18, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- 0011 Productions - Everything Is a Miracle for Dusk
- 0011 Productions - Pale Rising Moon for Mr. Nothing
- 0011 Productions - Gourmet for FEater
08 RHODES FASHION REVIEW OPEN
DURATION: July 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 18, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: 62 Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including: Dreambind Castle - Dream Within a Dreammare for Phantom, Test Collection Series - The Law for Saria, EPOQUE Collection - Miraculous Moment for Grani.
09 FESTIVAL PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED-TIME
DURATION: July 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 18, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
3.5 Anniversary Resupply Pack
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 13, Nucleic Crystal Sinter * 2, Crystalline Electronic Unit * 2, Transmuted Salt Agglomerate * 2, Transmuted Salt * 2
Rhodes Island Upgrade Pack
CONTENTS: Orundum * 5000, LMD * 100000, Chip Catalyst * 2, and Skill Summary - 1 * 50.
Yumen Sightseeing Pack

CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 24, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 2, LMD * 200000, Strategic Battle Record * 20, Tactical Battle Record * 30, Chip Catalyst * 2, Refined Solvent * 4, Cutting Fluid Solution * 4
Rhodes Island Special Pack
CONTENTS: Originium * 51, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1, Orundum * 2100, and Furniture Part * 1000.
[Rhodes Island Resource Pack]

CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 90, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1, LMD * 200000, Strategic Battle Record * 30, Tactical Battle Record * 40, Skill Summary - 3 * 20, Skill Summary - 2 * 50, Chip Catalyst * 4, Data Supplement Instrument * 10, and Data Supplement Stick * 30.
Lin's Wallet
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 16, LMD * 700000
Special Training Pack
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 11, Senior Operator Training Apparatus * 1
Senior Operator Training Apparatus: You can promote a hired ★5 Operator to Elite 2 Lv.80 (effective for Elite 2 Operators). Upgrade materials already spent will not be returned.
Advanced Special Training Pack
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 19, Top Operator Training Apparatus * 1
Top Operator Training Apparatus: You can promote a hired ★6 Operator to Elite 2 Lv.90 (effective for Elite 2 Operators). Upgrade materials already spent will not be returned.
Rhodes Island Headhunting Pack
CONTENTS: When purchasing this Headhunting Pack, a customization is required for purchase, which is as follows:
Type-α Headhunting Permit (Possible 6-star Operator: Dorothy, SilverAsh, and Surtr)
Type-β Headhunting Permit (Possible 6-star Operator: Carnelian, Kal'tsit, and Angelina)
Type-γ Headhunting Permit (Possible 6-star Operator: Fiammetta, Pozëmka, and Mountain)
10 CHIP PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED-TIME
Caster Chip Pack
DURATION: July 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 11, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Caster Dualchip * 4, Caster Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
Universal Chip Pack
DURATION: July 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 11, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Guard Dualchip * 4, Guard Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
Monthly Chip Choice Pack
DURATION: Available from August 01, 2023, 04:00 (UTC-7). Limited to 2 purchases per month.
CONTENTS: Automatic Chip Pack Etcher * 1
Automatic Chip Pack Etcher: Enables the printing of any class chip (provides Chip Packs * 8 and Chips * 5 for the corresponding class)
11 NEW FURNITURE SET – YUMEN CLINIC
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Yumen Clinic, will be available during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow event rewards and redeem in Composer's Mailbox (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces): July 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 18, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
12 OPERATORS UPDATE IN RECRUITMENT
UPDATE TIME: July 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: After the update, the following Operators will be permanently added to Recruitment.
★★★★★★ Rosa
★★★★★ Leonhardt
★★★★ Podenco
NOTE:

During the update, those tags that have not started recruitment will be mandatorily refreshed. Please refer to the official announcements for details on the mandatory refresh and related compensation.
13 RHODES ISLAND FESTIVAL SIGN-IN EVENT
DURATION: July 29, 2023, 04:00 (UTC-7) - August 19, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players will receive a Red Envelope containing bonus Orundum on Day 1, 5, 7, and 10 each. Players can also make up for Red Envelopes by signing in cumulatively, but each Red Envelope can only be claimed once after it is unlocked. Players can log in for 15 days to receive generous rewards, including: Event Exclusive Furnitures, Red Envelopes, Emergency Sanity Concentrate, etc.
Day 1: [Plum Blossom Joy] * 1, Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1
Day 2: Transmuted Salt * 3, LMD * 30000
Day 3: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 4: Skill Summary - 3 * 8, Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1
Day 5: Compound Cutting Fluid * 3, Frontline Battle Record * 25
Day 6: Chip Catalyst * 1, Skill Summary - 2 * 20
Day 7: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 8: Transmuted Salt Agglomerate * 1, Furniture Part * 200
Day 9: [New Life for a Dead Tree] * 1, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 10: Data Supplement Instrument * 5, Pure Gold * 20
Day 11: Cutting Fluid Solution * 1, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Day 12: Strategic Battle Record * 15, Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1
Day 13: Module Data Block * 1, Furniture Part * 200
Day 14: Chip Catalyst * 1, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 15: Skill Summary - 3 * 8, LMD * 30000
Red Envelope Day 1: A new year of fine fortune.
Red Envelope Day 5: Great mirth, great wealth.
Red Envelope Day 7: May you race to blue skies.
Red Envelope Day 10: All rejoice in full moons.
NOTE:
Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
